headword: {念願成就|ねんがんじょうじゅ}

definitions.gloss: fulfillment of a long-cherished wish; realization of a dream
definitions.explanation: The achievement of something one has wished for or worked toward over a long period. A four-character compound with a celebratory and somewhat formal tone.

examples.japanese: ついに{念願成就|ねんがんじょうじゅ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: My long-cherished wish has finally come true.

examples.japanese: {十年|じゅうねん}⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧{念願成就|ねんがんじょうじゅ}し、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: After ten years, my dream was fulfilled and I was able to open my own shop.

examples.japanese: ⟦{神社|じんじゃ}→神社：01620_jinja⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{念願成就|ねんがんじょうじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御礼|おれい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参拝|さんぱい}する→参拝する：15627_sanpaisuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{絶|た}えない→絶える：13814_taeru⟧。
examples.english: There is no end of people visiting the shrine to give thanks for the fulfillment of their wishes.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{念願|ねんがん}→念願：17955_nengan⟧ (long-cherished wish) and ⟦{成就|じょうじゅ}→成就：12687_jouju⟧ (accomplishment, fulfillment). A classical four-character compound (yojijukugo) with roots in Buddhist terminology, where ⟦{成就|じょうじゅ}→成就：12687_jouju⟧ originally meant the completion of spiritual practice or prayer.

USAGE:
Often used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ to form a verb phrase. Common in contexts involving personal achievements, religious prayers, and celebrations. Appears on ⟦{絵馬|えま}→絵馬：05957_ema⟧ (votive plaques) at shrines and temples. The tone is elevated and celebratory.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {念願成就|ねんがんじょうじゅ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to have one's wish fulfilled
- {念願成就|ねんがんじょうじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{御礼|おれい}: thanks for a fulfilled wish
- {念願成就|ねんがんじょうじゅ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{祈|いの}る→祈る：01198_inoru⟧: to pray for the fulfillment of a wish
- {念願成就|ねんがんじょうじゅ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{守|まも}り→お守り：05955_omamori⟧: charm for wish fulfillment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {大願成就|たいがんじょうじゅ}: fulfillment of a great ambition — a grander, more formal variant emphasizing the scale of the wish
- ⟦{念願|ねんがん}→念願：17955_nengan⟧: long-cherished wish — the first half of the compound, usable on its own
- {悲願達成|ひがんたっせい}: achievement of a long-held aspiration — similar meaning with a slightly more solemn nuance of overcoming hardship
